#### Changelog Entry

Please add a changelog entry for your changes using [Changie](https://changie.dev/):

```bash
changie new
```

Select the appropriate change kind (breaking, feature, fix, misc) and provide a brief description of your changes. This creates a file in `.changes/unreleased/` that will be included in the next release notes.

For more information, see [.changes/README.md](.changes/README.md).
